title: Assembly: Max of Three
description: Practice max of three in Assembly.

codeTemplate.asm:
; Assembly program
section .data
    msg db 'Max of Three',0
section .text
    global _start
_start:
    mov eax, 4
    mov ebx, 1
    mov ecx, msg
    int 0x80
    mov eax, 1
    xor ebx, ebx
    int 0x80
